observations.task_scope: Replace provisional units with least-privilege services, systemd credential paths, an independent App Server Unix socket, and native lifecycle evidence.
observations.provisional_unit_defects: The checked-in router entrypoint and config argument do not match M5.1, while the app-server/web units assume an unverified socket integration and use Requires dependencies that weaken restart independence.
observations.local_cli_observation: The read-only Codex 0.144.5 help exposes app-server --listen unix://PATH and app-server proxy --sock PATH; no account or model request was used.
observations.pinned_codex_web_observation: The pinned MIT codex-web bundle invokes CODEX_CLI_PATH with -c features.code_mode_host=true app-server --analytics-default-enabled over stdio, so the wrapper needs an explicit proxy mode for a separately supervised server.
observations.systemd_credential_model: Use LoadCredential/ImportCredential plus %d file paths; systemd root-owned read-only mounts are accepted only for the exact CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY under /run/credentials, while ordinary files retain service-user ownership checks.
observations.native_linux_result: The authorized Ubuntu 24.04 host and GitHub Actions both passed the sanitized independent lifecycle verification with no real account configured.

residual_risks: The installed Ubuntu validation stack uses fixture Codex/App Server and codex-web processes; it is deployment-topology evidence, not a production account deployment.
The deployment proxy path is pinned to a Codex CLI that exposes app-server proxy; the local observed binary is 0.144.5 while the earlier task baseline was 0.144.2.
M0.3, M3.5, and M4.1 real-account switching rows remain unrun by user direction; M5.2 used no real account or switch test and makes no seamless continuity claim.
